name: 267. Agent Gateway push deliveries: identical appends are at least once and one registration's deliveries keep their order (a2a-push-delivery) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-5477 (PR5 preservation group 3a), the delivery half of folder 266's fixture (tests/e2e/api/runners/a2a-push-fixture.mjs): the fixture is both the upstream agent that pushes to the gateway's ingress with the credential the gateway registered (POST /control/push) and the client's callback that records what the gateway delivers (/push-sink/<run>). The harness gateway must allow private push callbacks (server.a2a_allow_private_push_callbacks, set in the python profile) since the sink is on loopback. Pins on the wire: two identical artifact appends pushed by the upstream are both delivered (an append carries no event identity, so appends are at least once instead of being deduplicated away), and when the sink refuses a replacement once, the append accepted after it waits and is delivered after the retried replacement (one registration's deliveries keep acceptance order). Red on main ff00d1500 at 267.6 (one delivery) and 267.10 (the append overtakes the replacement); green on this change.
